profile.description: Cost-effective video generator based on Wan-2.7 (with synchronized audio). Ideal for content creators, marketers, educators and hobbyists who want quick quality video output without the heavy resource cost. Optionally you can upload a reference image to generate a video with Wan-2.7.
profile.poweredBy: Powered by Wan-2.7, a model that is hosted by @empiriolabsai.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
**Wan 2.7 Video Generation Pricing**

Pricing is per second of video generated.

**All Modes (T2V, I2V, Video Edit, R2V)**
| Resolution | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------------|------------|---------------|
| 720P | $0.10/sec | 3,333 pts/sec |
| 1080P | $0.150/sec | 5,000 pts/sec |

**Note:** Video Edit and R2V are billed for input video duration + output video duration.
